officeDescription: A desk, a laptop, and an idea you just can't shake.
landingDesc: One page, one form, your first client.
restaurantDesc: Menu, bookings and a restaurant dashboard.
appDesc: App, API, authentication and integration tests.
focusHint: Keep the rhythm to find your flow.
goalDesc0: Wood flooring, a new bench and three team seats.
goalDesc1: Glass facade, meeting area and six team seats.
goalDesc2: Invest in operations and automate your recurring income.
maxOffice: More offices in a future release
saveError: Couldn't save. Keep the game open and check your storage.
teamSubtitle: Everyone has a career. Mid-level at level 10, senior at level 20.
capacity: Expand the company to create more seats.
emptyTeam: For now, you're the whole team.
emptyTeamHint: Your first developer will handle projects automatically.
upgradesSubtitle: Equip the studio and increase production.
coffeeDesc: The first line of code follows the first sip.
keyboardDesc: Now your good ideas make a sound.
monitorDesc: Double the screen. Fewer lost windows.
fiberDesc: Your deploys finally keep up with your ideas.
contractsSubtitle: Ship projects, train your team and progress through the tiers.
finishFirst: Finish the current project to switch
privacy: Progress stays on this device. This version sends no personal data, shows no ads, and offers no purchases.
offlineIntro: Your team and operations kept producing.
offlineCap: Up to 8 hours per absence. Earnings are already in your balance.
expansionText: A new space for the next chapter of your story.
tutorial0: It all starts with a tap. Ready to work?
tutorial1: First delivery! Buy a coffee in Upgrades.
tutorial2: Next goal: R$ 1,500 for your first developer.
tutorial3: Your company now works for you.
backup: Your progress was recovered from the local backup.
corrupt: Your save and backup could not be read. They were preserved. You may explore a temporary session, but it will not replace your progress. Back up your browser data before attempting recovery.
future: This progress was saved by a newer version. Update the game to continue. Your save was preserved.
unavailable: Storage unavailable. This session is temporary and cannot be saved.
canvasLabel: Animated garage with founder, computers, and employees
profitHint: Team contract + automated operations − salaries and office costs. Revenue arrives after each delivery or cycle. Manual operations are excluded from continuous income estimates.
offlineReady: Available offline after the first full load.
singleTab: The game is already open in another tab. Continue there or close it and reload this tab.
starterProject: Starter project. Available from the garage.
legacyProject: Finish this ongoing delivery once; subsequent contracts require all conditions again.
migrated: Progress updated to version 0.2. Money, team, upgrades and contract completion percentage were preserved. New contracts require earlier deliveries, a qualified team and the right office. Project history starts now because the previous version did not record it. An existing old contract can finish once; an incompatible queue was removed. A copy of the old save is retained.
directHire: Starts at level {level}, with the rank’s productivity and salary.
hirePremium: Price includes training costs and a 25% direct-hiring premium.
missionsHint: One-time rewards. Past deliveries count; promotions are recorded from this update onward. Profit = estimated revenue minus salaries and office expenses.
missionsComplete: All available missions have been claimed. Great work!
dismissExplanation: Dismiss {name}? You recover {amount} (30% of hiring and training investment). This developer stops producing and receiving a salary.
dismissContractHint: If requirements are no longer met, finish the current delivery once; an ineligible queue is cancelled.
estimatedInvestment: Estimated investment for this developer from an older save. The current delivery may finish once; the queue will be rechecked.
dismissed: Developer dismissed. Recovered investment added to balance.
operation_sitesDesc: Turn deliveries into a portfolio of websites with recurring maintenance.
operation_menusDesc: A subscription that keeps restaurant menus online.
operation_commerceDesc: Recurring income from infrastructure for your clients' online stores.
operation_appsDesc: Your team launches a family of apps with income of its own.
operation_saasDesc: One product for thousands of businesses. Your studio's next chapter.
operationMilestoneHint: At level {level}, this operation's entire income doubles.
operationComplete: All milestones for this operation completed.
operationOfflineHint: Up to 8 h offline per absence. Income after service costs.
operationAutomationHint: One payment to repeat cycles, including offline.
operationLaunchHint: Starts manually. This operation earns independently and uses no team slot.
operationInvested: Investment completed. Check your next milestone!
operationAutomated: Automation active! The next cycles start by themselves.
operationNextCycle: The current cycle keeps its payout; the increase applies to the next one.
operationManualRate: Estimate with cycles kept active. Automate to produce without more taps.
financeForecastHint: Based on current production; contracts and cycles pay on completion. Idle manual operations are excluded.
financeActualHint: Investments and prizes change cash but not operating result. Unpaid costs become overdue obligations.
financeMonthDuration: 1 game month = 10 minutes of production; offline time counts up to 8 hours per absence.
financeMigrated: History starts with this version. Your previous balance was preserved.
financeMovementsHint: Amounts grouped by category and game month.
financeEstimateHint: Estimates use current production. Revenue arrives when contracts and cycles finish.
recoveryNormalHint: Watch upcoming bills and keep a reserve for payroll and office costs.
recoveryWarningHint: The forecast shows less than one month of cash. Review upcoming investments.
recoveryCrisisHint: Unpaid costs become overdue. New income pays outstanding obligations first.
recoveryRecoveredHint: Overdue bills have been paid. Watch cash before expanding again.
recoveryPriority: Automatic payment order: payroll, office, then installments.
recoveryLoanOffer: Receive {principal}; repay {total} in 12 installments of {installment} per game month.
recoveryLoanHint: Available only with overdue bills; one loan at a time. Total interest: 18%.
recoveryDownsizeHint: The whole team must fit. Unavailable queued contracts may be removed.
recoveryRenegotiateHint: Cuts overdue rent by 25% and costs 2 reputation. Available every 6 game months.
recoverySellHint: Receive 50% of the latest level's price; productivity decreases.
recoveryOfflineHint: Bills are overdue. Continue to review your recovery options.
bankruptcyGoalHint: Production has ended. Review the report and choose to restart.
bankruptcyReason: Overdue bills of {due} exceeded the {limit} limit after {months} months in crisis, and the recovery period ended.
bankruptcyReviewHint: Production is paused. Adjust the company before resuming; reloading does not renew the deadline.
bankruptcyConfirmBody: The report will be kept in your career. Cash, team and projects restart; settings and records remain saved.
careerPartial: Peaks and duration before the update were not recorded.
contractEstimateHint: Estimate for one full delivery with your current team. Includes payroll and office costs; clicks speed it up.
contractTermsHint: Repeats automatically. Queued deadlines start with production. Late delivery pays 10% less. Offline time counts too (up to 8h).
allocationHint: Reserve staff still receive salary. Deadlines stay fixed. Estimate excludes clicks; allocation follows the queue.
stageExplanation: Development 70% → Testing 25% → Delivery 5%. Payment follows all three stages.
